faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Assam Rifles Public School Accountant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Accountant post is 05-09-2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Accountant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Commerce graduates or have fifteen years of service as a clerk in Defence Services. A Basic Computer Application course/Diploma of at least one year duration with knowledge of accounting software is also required.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Accountant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Accountant post at Assam Rifles Public School.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Accountant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Accountant post will receive a salary ranging from Rs 14,000/- to Rs 16,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post to the specified address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required experience for the Accountant role?
faq.answer: A minimum of 5 years of experience as an Account clerk in the Force or a reputed organization is required for this position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Accountant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Accountant recruitment will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the Assam Rifles Public School located?
faq.answer: Assam Rifles Public School is located in Shillong, Meghalaya, with the pincode 793010.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What documents need to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to submit their complete bio-data, photograph, and supporting documents of education and experience certificates along with the application form.
